independent_verification.recovered_law: TEXT A presents events as caused by deliberate agents acting with purpose and concern (Achilles calls the assembly because Hera put it in his mind; Hera acts because she cared for the Danaans). TEXT B removes all intentional agency and causation, replacing it with events that arise 'from nowhere' and 'without cause,' making phenomena self-generating and agentless.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both identify removal of deliberate agency, but DECLARED specifies replacement with direct cosmic/divine intervention (heaven rupturing the ground), while RECOVERED describes replacement with agentless, causeless self-generating events — overlapping on bypassing hero agency but differing on whether divine force or pure absence replaces it.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final line of TEXT B maintains the agentless, causeless framing — things 'already before blindly were flung scattered' with no deliberate agent, consistent with the changed relation throughout.

kernel.governing_law: A mortal hero, prompted by divine compassion, summons the collective to confront a crisis of mass death — initiative is delegated downward from heaven through a single human will into communal assembly.
kernel.mutated_relation: The crisis erupts not through delegation but through unmediated cosmic intervention — heaven itself ruptures the ground, bypassing hero and assembly alike, making the collective not summoned but shattered.

kernel.governing_law: The moment of killing-potential is suspended not by the agent's own resolution but by an external intelligence that seizes the body at the threshold of the irreversible act — and the seized agent, recognizing the seizer, converts his violence into prophecy.
kernel.mutated_relation: The conditions that must already hold for such a seizure to be possible: the body has already divided itself before the intervention — the split precedes the goddess — and the "external" force is the name given to the interval the division itself opens; recognition is not of another but of the delay one has already become.
